props.body:
**Thunderbird Teams**

Thunderbird teams form the heart of our program, representing about 90% of our activities. These teams are highly competitive and participate in the Cincinnati Premier Youth Basketball League (CPYBL). Registration for Thunderbird teams costs approximately $160 and includes a weekly practice session, a 10-game season, and entry into a postseason tournament.

Our program is open to boys and girls from grades 1 through 12. Boys in grades 1 and 2 play in an in-house league, while those in grades 3 through 12 compete in the CPYBL. When registering, avoid selecting the "SELECT" option. Thunderbird teams generally practice at Lakota schools and play a season with 5 home games and 5 away games from December to March.

**Thunderbird Flight Teams**

In addition to our regular teams, we offer select basketball teams known as Thunderbird Flight. Preseason tryouts are held to form 1-2 boys' and girls' teams for grades 3-6. Flight team participants incur additional fees, which cover professional training, extra practice time, and a 20-game season.

props.body:
**Mission Statement**

- Promote boys' and girls' basketball in the Lakota School District area.
- Develop high-level basketball players in grades 1 through 6.
- Offer competitive basketball opportunities from grades 1 through 12.
- Establish teams based on skill assessment and a formal selection process.
- Enforce a code of conduct for coaches, players, and parents.
- Integrate with AAU and Lakota School System basketball programs whenever possible.

props.body:
**Registration Information**

1. **Returning Players:** If you played on a Thunderbird team last year and plan to return to the same team, attending the in-person assessment is recommended. Details for the assessment date and times can be found at https://www.tbirdhoops.org/news_article/show/1235298. You can sign up online and are encouraged to attend to confirm your uniform size.

2. **New or Changing Teams:** If you are new to the Thunderbird organization or will be joining a different team this year, you are strongly encouraged to attend the in-person assessments. Details can be found at https://www.tbirdhoops.org/news_article/show/1235298. This will allow for proper uniform sizing, participation in a brief skills assessment (3 stations), and the opportunity to have any questions answered. Ensure you register online prior to the assessments.

props.body:
Basketball is an excellent choice for individuals seeking a sport that combines skill, fitness, strategic thinking, and teamwork. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, basketball offers numerous benefits that can enhance your life both physically and socially.

Participating in basketball can improve your fitness levels, as it involves running, jumping, and quick movements that contribute to cardiovascular health and overall endurance. Additionally, the sport requires coordination and agility, helping to enhance motor skills and balance.

Strategic thinking is an integral part of basketball, as players must analyze the game, anticipate opponents' moves, and make split-second decisions on offense and defense. This aspect of the sport fosters critical thinking skills and enhances mental agility.

Moreover, basketball is a team sport, emphasizing collaboration, communication, and camaraderie. Playing as part of a team not only promotes social interaction but also teaches valuable life skills such as teamwork, leadership, and sportsmanship.

Whether you're interested in playing casually with friends or competitively in organized leagues, our organization provides an ideal environment to learn new skills, improve fitness, and forge lasting friendships.

props.body:
### Welcome to Lakota Thunderbird Youth Basketball!

We're thrilled to welcome you and your child to the Lakota Thunderbird Youth Basketball Organization for what promises to be a rewarding and energetic season! This year is all about growth—on and off the court. Your child will sharpen their skills, build lasting friendships, and experience the joy of teamwork in a supportive environment.

As a vital part of our Thunderbird family, your involvement helps shape a successful and memorable experience for everyone. To ensure a smooth season, we ask that you keep the following in mind:

blocks.source_brief: Welcome section greeting families to Lakota Thunderbird Youth Basketball and framing the season from the body.
blocks.source_quote: We're thrilled to welcome you and your child to the Lakota Thunderbird Youth Basketball Organization for what promises to be a rewarding and energetic season! This year is all about growth—on and off the court.

props.body:
**What We Ask of Our Families:**

1. **Attend the Parent Meeting** — Get connected early! You'll meet your child's coach, team representatives, and other families while learning about schedules, uniforms, rules, and expectations. Your coach will share specific details ahead of time.

2. **Be Prompt and Prepared** — Please ensure your child arrives on time for practices and games with the right gear. Being well-fed, rested, and hydrated makes a big difference in their performance and enjoyment.

3. **Be a Positive Presence** — Cheer with encouragement! We ask all spectators to model respect—no sideline coaching or criticism. Please let the coaches coach and officials officiate. Approaching referees about game decisions is not allowed.

4. **Lend a Helping Hand** — We count on our parent volunteers! Whether it's snacks, fundraising, scorekeeping, or working concessions, your help keeps the program running strong.

5. **Keep the Communication Flowing** — Stay in touch with your coach or team rep for any questions or concerns. Timely replies help us keep things organized and responsive.

6. **Support Growth and Sportsmanship** — Celebrate effort, not just outcomes. Encourage resilience, teamwork, and a love for the game—even in the face of setbacks.

We're excited for the journey ahead and grateful to have your family with us. Thank you for being a part of our growing community.
